title: Schnozzberry Drink
html:
Quest Giver: Khodebshchik

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Go to side areas off of the 1st and 3rd levels of Ratsputin's Gulag. Find and kill Arctic Blademasters or Frostbitten Blasters for 15 Frostbitten Schnozzes and kill Ebon Devastators for 20 Eye Berries. Return to Khodebshchik in Ratsputin's Holding Cell when completed.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Khodebshchik

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Go to side areas off of the 1st and 3rd levels of Ratsputin's Gulag. Find and kill Arctic Blademasters or Frostbitten Blasters for 15 Frostbitten Schnozzes and kill Ebon Devastators for 20 Eye Berries. Return to Khodebshchik in Ratsputin's Holding Cell when completed.

Offer:

I'm not too sure about that last Schnozzberry batch. If the drink is of the flavor to your liking, then I will continue to put my crafty hands to their craft. Just make sure that you continue to bring Khodebshchik fifteen Frostbitten Schnozzes and twenty Eye Berries. I'm asking for a little extra so that I can continue to experiment and fine tune the recipe. If you should forget, you can always find me here in Ratsputin's Holding Cell when you need another made.

Remember, you can find Arctic Blademasters and Frostbitten Blasters in the side dungeons of Upper Ratsputin's Gulag in the same areas as the Ebon Devastators.

Turn-in:

Here is your Schnozzberry drink. Did you want a cherry or umbrella with that? How about a crazy straw?

You are most gullible to think this should be served with a straw, or you are smart to give in to my amusements. Either way, I'll keep asking it, but don't ever think for a nanu nanu second that I am serious. Oh, and if you see that man's dead father, please tell him that I'm sorry. I thought I was brewing up a cleaning agent for someone.

Objectives:

  • Frostbitten Schnozzes ×15
  • Eye Berries ×20

Level range: 75–95
